subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this locked PR-limit notice remain open and pinned as the canonical contributor-policy announcement, or should maintainers unpin and close it now that the policy is documented and shipped?
rationale: A maintainer renamed, pinned, and reopened the issue after the original docs fix, so automation should not infer the intended public-notice lifecycle from source implementation alone.

options.title: Keep pinned notice open
options.body: Preserve the issue as the visible canonical announcement while CONTRIBUTING and automation remain aligned to the 20-PR cap.

options.title: Close as superseded by docs
options.body: Unpin and close the issue if maintainers no longer want an open GitHub notice now that the release contains matching docs and automation.

options.title: Replace with a fresh policy thread
options.body: Close this older notice only after opening a clearer maintainer-authored policy thread or discussion that owns future cap changes.

recommendation.title: Keep pinned notice open
recommendation.body: Preserve the issue as the visible canonical announcement while CONTRIBUTING and automation remain aligned to the 20-PR cap.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman performed the 20-cap rename, pin, and reopen actions visible in the issue timeline and has adjacent override-policy history.
